cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Fluent in Nonsense
cards.instruction: Perform complete mastery of the strange logic while inventing each rule only when it becomes necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we price this bottled cloud, measure its third elbow. Bring the result to me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm your new assistant. It only has two. May I open the bottle?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may address it first. 'Professor' is sufficient; the third elbow appears only for respectful staff.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Professor. It's raining now. Shall I stop?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Continue. Those are its credentials, and I decide when they're sufficient. Count ten drops through the glass and write the price. Any more and we'll be selling an overqualified cloud.

reason: Reread found catching drops outside a still-closed bottle required an unstated opening. Count through the glass and explicitly write the price, preserving the exact experiment and authority tactic.
